hotspots.title: Trump’s birthright citizenship crackdown sparks fury
hotspots.blurb: President Trump signed two executive orders aiming to restrict birthright citizenship and curb 'birth tourism,' despite legal challenges and past Supreme Court rejections. The moves target children of undocumented immigrants and foreign diplomats.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes legal and moral implications, polarizing public opinion and igniting debates over immigration and constitutional rights.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s Head Start overhaul sparks outrage
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration proposed sweeping changes to the Head Start program, including removing federal standards, lowering administrative expense caps, and giving states more control. Critics warn this could weaken educational quality and access for low-income children.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot remains charged due to its perceived attack on a long-standing social safety net, evoking strong emotional responses from educators, parents, and advocacy groups.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s diplomatic tour ignites regional tensions
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei’s visit to Ecuador to sign bilateral agreements with Daniel Noboa has escalated tensions with Brazil and domestic opponents. His confrontational style and policy shifts, including military exercises with Brazil despite diplomatic strains, have drawn criticism.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to Milei’s polarizing leadership and the high affective investment in his defiance of traditional diplomatic norms, sparking both celebration and outrage.

hotspots.title: AfD surges to record poll leads in Germany
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) has reached a record 28% in polls, widening its lead over the CDU/CSU. The party’s rise is fueled by anti-immigration rhetoric, economic discontent, and perceived judicial bias, with critics warning of democratic backsliding.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is white-hot due to the AfD’s rapid ascent, its extremist associations, and the existential stakes for Germany’s political future, evoking fear and moral panic.

hotspots.title: Ceuta migration crisis unites Spain’s far-left and far-right
hotspots.blurb: Spain’s far-left Sumar and far-right Vox have united to demand Morocco’s exclusion from co-hosting the 2030 FIFA World Cup, citing the recent migration crisis in Ceuta. The unusual alliance highlights the charged political climate around immigration and national sovereignty.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the rare convergence of ideological extremes, the moral charge of migration debates, and the symbolic stakes of the World Cup.
